2607.02119.title: An Efficient vLLM-Based Inference Pipeline for Unified Audio Understanding and Generation
2607.02119.paper_summary: While Large Multimodal Models excel in comprehension, high-throughput inference engines lack native support for multimodal generation. This is severe in Speech Language Models, where generating multi-layered audio tokens via decoupled AR+NAR or synchronous Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) with delay-pattern interleaving conflicts with standard single-stream loops. We present a vLLM-based inference pipeline for unified speech understanding and generation. We extend autoregressive decoding to natively execute delay-pattern de-interleaving and coordinated multi-stream sampling, integrating an on-GPU acoustic decoder for end-to-end waveform synthesis. Crucially, we overcome the shared intuition that Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) halves throughput. By co-scheduling paired conditional and unconditional requests within a continuous batch, our CFG implementation sustains 80% of non-CFG throughput, absorbing dual-request and logit merging overheads. We open-source our framework.
2607.02119.paper_summary_zh: 大型多模態模型在理解方面表現優異，但高通量推理引擎對多模態生成缺乏原生支持。這在語音語言模型中尤為嚴重，因為通過解耦的自回歸+非自回歸或同步多標記預測（MTP）生成多層音頻標記與標準單流循環存在衝突。我們提出了一個基於vLLM的推理管道，用於統一的語音理解和生成。我們擴展了自回歸解碼，以原生執行延遲模式去交錯和協調的多流採樣，整合了一個在GPU上的聲學解碼器，用於端到端的波形合成。關鍵是，我們克服了共享直覺，即無分類器引導（CFG）會將吞吐量減半。通過在連續批次中共同調度配對的條件和無條件請求，我們的CFG實現保持了80%的非CFG吞吐量，吸收了雙請求和logit合併的開銷。我們將我們的框架開源。
